notes: Preset values and estimate calibration for CFD runs (building-energy-cfd-p2-contract.md S8). Bounds, preset membership and the panel metadata are the CFD Settings Catalog: x-cfd-setting in tests/contracts/cfd-run-request-v1.schema.json, generated into cfd_settings_catalog.py (docs/architecture/cfd-settings-catalog-adr.md).
Contract bounds and the compute hard cap stay out of this file (cfd_settings_catalog.REQUEST_FIELD_BOUNDS, CFD_MAX_CELLS_PER_DIRECTION); this file never widens them.
The standard preset must reproduce the service defaults exactly; changing a value here changes the service default and needs an owner decision.
